inj.note: Mays missed the first five games of the season while recovering from a fractured wrist and is now in danger of missing additional time. Juice Scruggs will likely take over as the team's starting center while Mays is sidelined.

news.h: Lions to get DB Brian Branch, C Cade Mays back vs. Packers
news.d: The Lions will have both Branch and center Cade Mays for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
